cases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This is a fictional product example, not an actual Lantern Gate Studios release or production
> credit. It is intended to be replaced with the studio's real words and media.

Seven travelers arrive at a sealed mountain gate as an old ward begins to fail. This companion page
keeps the episode, production context, and accessible transcript in creator-owned Markdown.

## Chapters

00:00 The road beneath the mountain
00:42 A warning in the ash
01:36 The gate answers
02:28 Beyond the threshold

## Production log

- [x] Story beat and continuity review
- [x] Shot list and animatic
- [x] Voice and sound pass
- [ ] Final color and accessibility review
- [ ] Release copy and scheduled publication

## Shot notes

The opening uses a wide silhouette before moving to individual reaction shots. The gate remains the
visual anchor, while ember light distinguishes forbidden magic from ordinary torchlight.

## Transcript

**Narrator:** The mountain had no door on any map, but every road bent toward it.

**Mara:** Nobody touches the seal until we know who lit those runes.

**Narrator:** From the other side came a sound like a great chain falling through the dark.
